create_alexnet_deepcluster_model: create an AlexNetDeepCluster model trunk with sobel filters and batch normalization for deep clustering
build_alexnet_deepcluster_forward: build a forward pass through AlexNetDeepCluster returning intermediate feature outputs by key
register_alexnet_deepcluster_trunk: register AlexNetDeepCluster as a model trunk under the name alexnet_deepcluster
configure_alexnet_deepcluster_features: configure AlexNetDeepCluster feature blocks with conv, pool, and flatten layers
run_alexnet_deepcluster_inference: run inference on AlexNetDeepCluster with optional out_feat_keys to extract intermediate features
